parameters.toolDescription: Search the business knowledge base (menu, price lists, brochures, services, FAQ, policies) for information needed to answer the customer. Call this for any question about what the business offers, prices, how something works, or policies. Returns short text excerpts.

Get the authoritative current business profile and the list of physical branches/locations, with explicit guidance (locations_guidance) on whether that list is complete. Call this before answering anything about branches, locations, address, phone number, or working hours.

Hand this conversation to the human team. Use when the customer explicitly asks for a person, is upset or has a complaint you cannot resolve, or an order is ready for a human to finalize. After calling, tell the customer a teammate will follow up soon (no specific time).
Save the customer contact details when they provide them. Pass whatever you have. Returns whether name and phone are now both on file or which is still missing.

Begin taking an order when the customer wants to order. Then collect items, quantities, and any delivery detail conversationally. Order capture is conversational only - a teammate finalizes it, so also call save_lead and then request_human_handover once you have the items and the customer contact info.
Add more items or details to an order that is already in progress.

Use when the customer signals they are finished (for example thanks, that is all). Call with confirmed set to false - the system will show the customer a confirm or continue choice. Do not end the conversation yourself.
